scripts.build:native:mac-arm64: node-gyp rebuild --target=33.0.0 --arch=arm64 --dist-url=https://electronjs.org/headers && mkdir -p output/mac && cp build/Release/wemeet_electron_sdk.node output/mac/wemeet_electron_sdk.arm64.node
scripts.build:native:mac-x64: node-gyp rebuild --target=33.0.0 --arch=x64 --dist-url=https://electronjs.org/headers && mkdir -p output/mac && cp build/Release/wemeet_electron_sdk.node output/mac/wemeet_electron_sdk.x64.node
scripts.build:native:win-x64: node-gyp rebuild --target=33.0.0 --arch=x64 --dist-url=https://electronjs.org/headers && if not exist wemeet_sdk\win\x64 mkdir wemeet_sdk\win\x64 && copy build\Release\wemeet_electron_sdk.node wemeet_sdk\win\x64\wemeet_electron_sdk.node
scripts.build:native:mac: npm run build:native:mac-arm64 && npm run build:native:mac-x64
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: rm -rf output/mac/TMSDK.framework && cp -R wemeet_sdk/mac/Frameworks/arm64/TMSDK.framework output/mac/TMSDK.framework && node bootstrap/build.js --arm64
scripts.dist:mac:x64: rm -rf output/mac/TMSDK.framework && cp -R wemeet_sdk/mac/Frameworks/x64/TMSDK.framework output/mac/TMSDK.framework && node bootstrap/build.js --x64
scripts.create-universal-framework: rm -rf output/mac/TMSDK.framework && cp -R wemeet_sdk/mac/Frameworks/arm64/TMSDK.framework output/mac/TMSDK.framework && lipo -create wemeet_sdk/mac/Frameworks/arm64/TMSDK.framework/Versions/A/TMSDK wemeet_sdk/mac/Frameworks/x64/TMSDK.framework/Versions/A/TMSDK -output output/mac/TMSDK.framework/Versions/A/TMSDK && cp output/mac/TMSDK.framework/Versions/A/TMSDK output/mac/TMSDK.framework/TMSDK
scripts.dist:mac:universal: npm run create-universal-node && npm run create-universal-framework && node bootstrap/build.js --universal
scripts.postinstall:win: node-gyp rebuild --target=33.0.0 --arch=x64 --dist-url=https://electronjs.org/headers && if not exist wemeet_sdk\win\x64 mkdir wemeet_sdk\win\x64 && copy build\Release\wemeet_electron_sdk.node wemeet_sdk\win\x64\wemeet_electron_sdk.node
